subject: Post-call: MAP draft + Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft + Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling)

Hi Sophie  great call this morning, thanks for the time. As promised, attaching the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with a focused milestone for the integration build plan. High-level recap and next steps below.

Call recap:
- Goal: Integrate Redwood inference into ACME's customer support product for streaming summaries and tool calling to internal ticketing.
- Success criteria: <10% increase in latency at p50, acceptable quality on our evaluation prompt set, and production rollout by end of Q4.

MAP items (draft):
1) Integration build plan (owner: Marissa Cole)  SDK integration, streaming responses, tool calling hooks, structured output schema.
   - Milestones: SDK POC, Streaming SDK + KV cache test, Tool-calling adapter (Zendesk/Ticketing), Structured outputs + schema validation.
   - Target close for this MAP milestone: 2026-10-15
   - Dependencies: Network egress rules, API key provisioning, contract signature for Dedicated environment (if chosen).
2) Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence (owner: Rishi Malhotra)  delivery by 2026-08-15.
3) Commercial & procurement (owner: Laura Bennett)  finalize SOW and PO cadence.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), integration_spec.pdf (technical spec summary).

Immediate asks:
- Sophie / DevOps: confirm network/RBAC constraints and whether you need a VPC/private deployment or dedicated pool.
- ACME Procurement: expected PO timeline so we can align the target close date.
- Marissa: see the build milestones below  can you confirm owners and estimates?

I'll follow up with a versioned MAP in the Drive and update the milestones after we get input from DevOps and Procurement.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

Thanks Ben  appreciate the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side: 
- DevOps: we prefer the Dedicated pool for predictable throughput; we need network IP allowlist steps and an expected egress footprint.
- Procurement: we'll aim to share an initial PO by COB 2026-08-12, pending final SOW.

Regarding the integration milestones: can Marissa share estimated engineer effort per milestone (weeks) and whether there are any special infra requirements for tool calling (we use a self-hosted Zendesk connector behind our VPN).

Thanks for the draft, Ben  I reviewed the attachment and added inline notes in the Drive doc (link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP_ACME_v1). Quick responses inline here for clarity: 

- SDK POC (Owner: Marissa Cole)  2 engineers x 2 weeks to get a basic request/response integration and authentication flow validated. Deliverable: sample app + test harness.
- Streaming & KV cache test (Owner: Marissa Cole)  1 engineer x 2 weeks to enable streaming, measure latency, and validate prefix caching for common prompts. Deliverable: load test results and p50/p95 numbers.
- Tool-calling adapter (Owner: Marissa Cole + ACME DevOps)  2 engineers x 3 weeks. Need ACME to expose a staging endpoint or provide a VPN tunnel for the Zendesk connector. Deliverable: adapter with retries and idempotency handling.
- Structured outputs + schema validation (Owner: Marissa Cole + ACME Product)  1 engineer x 2 weeks to define JSON schema, validation, and test prompts. Deliverable: schema + integration tests.

Dependencies summary:
- ACME to provide staging endpoints and test credentials for ticketing system (DevOps).
- Network egress rules & firewall exceptions (DevOps).
- Procurement to confirm PO/SOW (Laura).

Proposed milestone dates (aligned to target close 2026-10-15):
- SDK POC: 2026-08-31
- Streaming & KV test: 2026-09-14
- Tool-calling adapter: 2026-09-28
- Schema + validation: 2026-10-05

I'll put owners into the MAP and flag any risks. If ACME prefers Dedicated immediately, we'll coordinate with infra to reserve capacity (lead time ~2 weeks from contract signature).

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
